scientific_integrity: Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not prove asymptotic results; analytic proof gives the claimed limits; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer power r≥2, homogeneous unit rates, canonical full/empty endpoint occupancies, pointwise bulk positions 0<t<1; generic parabolic scaling is prior knowledge and older equivalent transport analyses may exist.
title: Sharp finite-chain throughput and cotangent bulk profile for nonlinear steric transport
